The gateway coordinates a persistent Chromium profile and an authenticated noVNC desktop on Linux, with a logo wallpaper, status bar, and Chrome, Terminal, and Files launchers. Closing Chrome leaves the desktop available; agent use reattaches or opens Chromium as needed. Local Mac computer views keep the existing embedded browser tabs under gateway coordination.

Human takeover cancels and drains gateway execution until control is returned. Desktop gateways reject restricted Bots with network access because they could reach the shared browser's saved logins. Enable the desktop only after selecting compatible Bot policies. Password and OTP login work; remote passkeys and Touch ID forwarding are unavailable.

Gateway protocol 89 requires matching clients. Bot storage schema 6 removes custom webhook records; Cloud upgrades explicitly preserve an original database backup and apply the known schema change before starting the gateway. Portable exports exclude the desktop profile.
